title: Binary guard starting configuration
statement: Let $b,j\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string with $j\leq |x|$, and let $out,w$ be finite Boolean strings. The starting configuration has one work tape, Boolean tape alphabet, and loop states built from $\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Fin}(b+1))$; its state is the decrement phase, its guard component has phase $0$, input-head position $j+1$, and output $out$, and its work tape is initialized with buffer $w$ at head position $0$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the counter-loop configuration or buffer-tape encoding, so the exact resulting tape contents and state encoding cannot be expanded further.
